title: Bomb heat per mole
statement:
A bomb calorimeter with heat capacity 9.72 kJ/K warms by $[$t]$ K when 0.0600 mol of fuel burns. Find the combustion internal-energy change per mole of fuel.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Reverse the calorimeter sign before dividing by moles.

hints: Multiply the calibrated heat capacity by ΔT.
Reverse the calorimeter sign before dividing by moles.
solution: The calorimeter gains $9.72([$t])$ kJ, so $\Delta E_\mathrm{comb}=-9.72([$t])/0.0600$ kJ/mol.
